content: niri-session fix VALIDATED (runs 2026-10-03T16-34-07Z + 17-09-19Z, 77/80 x2): session survives ~297s (was 350ms); 3/6 runtime checks first-time green. 3 product bugs diagnosed: (1) niri-session pgrep dinit race loses on verify boots 2/2 -> fallback niri outside user dinit; fix=poll dinitctl before fallback (aports). (2) user dinit env lacks WAYLAND_DISPLAY -> wayvnc+polkit-agent crash-loop every boot; fix=setenv after dinitctl start returns (aports). (3) niri 25.11 QEMU screenshot-screen exits 0, writes nothing (all CLI shapes; stderr /dev/null). Harness fixes: screenshot check fresh-png compare + autologin dirs install -d user-owned 2700 both levels.

dinitctl --user list has TWO started formats: [{+}]=dependency-started, [[+]]=explicitly-started. niri started via dinitctl --user start niri renders [[+]] niri. Harness regex \{\+-only caused 3 false 'race lost' negatives. Real bug-3 root cause: niri in QEMU boots with ZERO wl_outputs (bochs card0 no mesa driver, virtio-gpu-gl card1 no guest venus/virgl) -> wayvnc No-output-found crash-loop + screenshot writes nothing.
